description: The plot illustrates the relative change in an unspecified metric across different layers, comparing various configurations. The x-axis is labeled with layer ranges (Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, Layer29-32) and has a categorical scale. The y-axis is labeled "Relative Change," has a linear scale, ranges from -15% to 5%, and has tick labels at intervals of 5%. The plot includes five lines representing different configurations: Baseline of 4×tokens, 4-bit (gray dashed line), LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit (yellow line with circle markers), LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit (red line with circle markers), RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit (light blue line with square markers), and RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit (dark blue line with square markers). The Baseline remains steady at 0% across all layer ranges. The LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit starts at approximately 0% and remains relatively stable, ending at around 0%. The LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit begins at around -1%, decreases to approximately -3% at Layer13-20, and then slightly increases to around -2% at Layer29-32. The RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit starts at around -2%, decreases to approximately -12% at Layer13-20, and then increases to around -4% at Layer29-32. The RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit begins at around -3%, sharply decreases to approximately -18% at Layer13-20, and then increases to around -5% at Layer29-32.
